news.bodyKey:
Thank you for following along with the development progress of Glam Rock TD!

Here's what's new:

VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS: Over half of the menus have recieved a visual overhaul. This is only the beginning, expect cleaner visuals coming through in the next update.

AUDIO UPDATES: Fixed minor bugs with footsteps and changed up multiple tracks and sfx.

GAMEPLAY BALANCING: Towers have recieved various balance adjustments. Including new upgrade paths!

PROFILES ARE ONLINE: You are now able to login/create a profile that will share it's progress across multiple platforms! Further updates to this system will be coming in the upcoming updates.

Thank you for your support!
